name: Bojhena she Bojhena
overview: Bojhena Se Bojhena is a Bengali romantic soap opera aired on Star Jalsha, a tale of romance between the arrogant Bengali cosmopolitan tycoon Aranya Singha Roy and small town girl innocent but free spirited Pakhi from Malda (Bengal) attracted to each other and their intense love-hate relationship culminating into marriage. Subsequently how the couple go through difficult periods , trials and triumphs. The world of the Singha Roy's and the Ghosh Dastidars - how these families adjust and support this romance. The last episode telecast is on 18 June 2016.
